newsitem.title: USA: HBO & Co to buy Management Software.
newsitem.headline: HBO & Co to buy Management Software.

text.p: HBO & Co said on Friday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire Management Software Inc (MSI), a privately held provider of software solutions for the homecare industry.
The company said in a statement MSI shareholders would get about 890,000 shares of HBO stock in the transaction. HBO shares ended down 2-5/8 at $50-1/2 on Thursday on the Nasdaq Stock Market.
The acquisition is subject to completion of a definitive agreement and regulatory approval. It is scheduled to be completed during the third quarter.
Management Software, based in Springfield, Mo., had 1995 revenue of $15 million and has over 200 employees.
